GUI lognormal · repeat scan.SpaceSniffer: No rescan command (menus: New, Export, Exit, Configure); views update live from file-system notifications.

GUI lognormal · memory growth over 10 re.SpaceSniffer: No rescan command, so there are no rescans to measure; views update live from file-system notifications.

GUI session · time to first result.TreeSize Free: Rows are drawn progressively in a virtual tree that exposes no rows to UI Automation or Win32, so the first row on screen cannot be timed.
GUI session · time to first result.SpaceSniffer: The treemap is drawn progressively with no observable row or item signal, so the first result on screen cannot be timed.

GUI session · reload saved results.TreeSize Free: The Free edition has no command to reopen a saved scan.
GUI session · reload saved results.SpaceSniffer: Scans can be exported (File > Export to file) but not reopened.
GUI session · reload saved results.Directory Report: Saves printed reports only; File > Open does not reopen a scan.
